title: Strategic Calibration in LLM Multi-Agent Systems: Audited Pivot Scoring for Truthful Elicitation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, reported confidence increasingly determines the allocation of scarce downstream attention, computation, and decision influence. This makes reporting strategic: an agent may overstate the relevance of its contribution even when its underlying belief is well calibrated. Existing calibration methods largely assume passive reporting and therefore do not address strategic incentives created when confidence determines downstream allocation. We formulate strategic calibration as a reporting-layer incentive problem and propose the Audited Pivot Scoring Mechanism (APSM). APSM offsets platform-controlled allocation benefits, uses inverse-propensity-weighted sparse audits, charges the Clarke pivot externality, and applies a strictly proper score. translated_title: LLM多智能体系统中的策略性校准：面向真实性引出的审计化Pivot评分机制
translated_abstract: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统中，所报告的置信度日益决定着稀缺的下游注意力、计算资源和决策影响力的分配。这使得报告行为具有策略性：即使智能体的底层信念校准良好，它也可能夸大其贡献的相关性。现有的校准方法大多假设被动报告，因此无法解决当置信度决定下游资源分配时产生的策略性激励问题。我们将策略性校准形式化为报告层的激励问题，并提出了审计化Pivot评分机制（APSM）。APSM抵消平台控制的分配收益，采用逆倾向加权稀疏审计，收取Clarke pivot外部性费用，并应用严格适当的评分规则。在所述模型假设下，真实报告是唯一的期望效用最优反应。我们还刻画了近似执行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了审计化Pivot评分机制（APSM），通过平台收益抵消、逆倾向加权稀疏审计、Clarke pivot外部性收费和严格适当评分规则的组合设计，使真实报告置信度成为LLM多智能体系统中唯一的期望效用最优策略，从而解决了置信度决定下游资源分配时产生的策略性虚报问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Audited Pivot Scoring Mechanism (APSM), which makes truthful confidence reporting the unique expected-utility best response in LLM multi-agent systems by combining allocation-benefit offsetting, inverse-propensity-weighted sparse audits, Clarke pivot externality charges, and a strictly proper score, thereby addressing strategic misreporting when confidence determines downstream allocation.
